description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for a wrapper around cURL multi handle operations, used for performing asynchronous HTTP requests within the network manager project. It includes abstraction via a virtual interface and singleton pattern for managing the implementation.

classes.name: CurlWrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface for cURL multi handle operations, intended to be implemented for mocking or specific behavior overrides.

classes.name: CurlWraps
classes.description: Manager class providing static access to cURL multi handle functions, employing a singleton pattern for implementation management.

methods.name: CurlWrapsImpl::~CurlWrapsImpl
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the interface, ensuring proper cleanup of derived classes.

methods.name: CurlWrapsImpl::curl_multi_perform
methods.description: Performs a cURL multi transfer, advancing the queued transfers.

methods.name: CurlWrapsImpl::curl_multi_info_read
methods.description: Checks for messages/transfer info from the cURL multi handle.

methods.name: CurlWrapsImpl::curl_multi_poll
methods.description: Waits for activity on the multi handle with a timeout, providing an alternative to `curl_multi_perform` polling.

methods.name: CurlWraps::setImpl
methods.description: Sets the implementation instance for the wrapper, facilitating dependency injection.

methods.name: CurlWraps::getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the wrapper class for cURL multi operations.

methods.name: CurlWraps::curl_multi_perform
methods.description: Static method to perform cURL multi transfer using the current implementation.

methods.name: CurlWraps::curl_multi_info_read
methods.description: Static method to read info from cURL multi handle, delegating to current implementation.

methods.name: CurlWraps::curl_multi_poll
methods.description: Static method to poll cURL multi handle, delegating to current implementation.
